name: Graig Gustafson Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large multi-section residence with a complex dark gray shingle roof and multiple gables|A large circular concrete driveway with a central landscaped island dominates the front and side area|A black pickup truck is parked on the driveway|The lot features extensive well-maintained green lawn, landscaping with shrubs and flowers around the foundation, and several raised garden beds visible in front of the circular drive and towards the front of the property|A fence separates the front and back yards|Mature trees and open lawn surround the house, with some wooded areas visible toward the rear

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows the main facade with a covered entry area and large windows|The circular concrete driveway loops in front of the house with a central landscaped island|A black pickup truck is parked near the center|Landscaping with flowers and shrubs lines the driveway and foundation|Mature trees and open green lawn extend outward|A fence separates the front from the back yards|A garden is to the right of the residence in front and raised garden beds along the front of the circular drive.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the large home with the circular driveway curving around|Landscaping and shrubs are present along the foundation|Mature trees frame the side, with open lawn and a fenced garden area visible in the distance|A patio dominates the area directly behind the house

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows a large bay window and an outdoor patio area featuring furniture and red/orange umbrellas|The circular driveway and central island are visible from this angle|Extensive green lawn and mature trees surround the rear, with water and wooded area in the foreground

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the multi-gabled roofline|The circular driveway and central landscaped island are visible, along with landscaping and shrubs|A fence separates the front and back yards|Mature trees and open lawn extend to the side, with the water and additional trees visible toward the rear.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a large circular paved driveway that allows easy turnaround and circulation in front of the house. The extensive open green lawn surrounding the residence provides excellent space for emergency vehicle staging and movement. Mature trees along the perimeter and sides may limit some visibility and sightlines but do not appear to create major obstructions. The layout offers relatively clear access around the main residence, with open areas at the front, sides, and rear.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property or the rear areas? Is vehicle access available to the back of the property? Are there any additional access points or pathways not visible from the available imagery?
